notes: Legacy events omit pre-DR formula base; candidate casts expose formulaBaseDamage/effectiveDR.
damageToHp includes every observed HP loss, including DOT/recoil; enemyDirectHpDamage only counts enemy actions.
Healing is observed applied healing from event HP deltas; simultaneous damage/heal may net within an event.
Fixtures are synthetic legal gear/progression builds, not copied live accounts.
Explore before uses the old original-profile plus weighted builder scaling; road before uses the old generic allocation, player+1 and original road template mapping.
Matched-mastery rows also control the old enemy level to the candidate tier level; actual-before weaker rows retain the old player-relative level.
